name: Forescout eyeFocus
description: This plugin is used to fetch Assets from the Assets page of Forescout eyeFocus Cloud platform. This plugin does not support any actions on Assets.

configuration.label: Base URL
configuration.description: Base URL of your Forescout eyeFocus Cloud instance. e.g. https://demo.cloud.forescout.com

configuration.label: API Token
configuration.description: Bearer API token used to authenticate against the Forescout eyeFocus REM Asset Search API.

configuration.label: Asset Categories
configuration.description: Asset categories to pull. Only assets whose Forescout category is selected here are pulled; the filter is applied by the plugin after each API call. All categories are selected by default. Leave empty to pull assets of every category. Deselect 'IT' to exclude Netskope-Client-compatible hosts (laptops / desktops / phones) and pull only non-host / headless assets.

configuration.label: Pull Strategy

choices.key: Full Window (refetch configured initial range every pull)

configuration.description: How each pull cycle determines its datetime range. 'Incremental': the first pull uses the Initial Range and every later pull fetches only assets seen since the last successful run. 'Full Window': every pull re-fetches all assets within the Initial Range, so existing assets are refreshed on each cycle.

configuration.label: Initial Range (in days)
configuration.description: Number of days to look back. With the 'Incremental' Pull Strategy this applies to the first pull only; with the 'Full Window' Pull Strategy it applies to every pull. Valid range: 1 to 365.

configuration.label: Pagination Window (in days)
configuration.description: Size of each datetime window the pull is sliced into (the REM API is paginated by narrowing the time window, not by page number). A window that still exceeds the 1000-asset API cap is automatically split into smaller sub-windows. Valid range: 1 to 30.

configuration.label: Apply Risk Score Filter
configuration.description: Select 'Yes' to filter the assets fetched by their Forescout risk score. Additional 'Minimum Risk Score' and 'Maximum Risk Score' fields are then displayed and are applied server-side by the REM Asset Search API. Select 'No' to fetch assets of every risk score.
